_comment: Wall-clock budgets in seconds, consumed by tools/Get-PhaseTimingReport.ps1. A value of 0 means unbudgeted (no gate). mode_totals gates a whole run per mode — QUICK carries the standing two-minute goal. phase_budgets maps a phase number (string; fractional numbers like "74.5" keep their decimal) to a per-phase ceiling that applies in any mode; add entries as phases get budgets.
